attributes: all 39 non-Smiling attributes in canonical order
single_release: For each retained draw compute attribute AUROC and balanced accuracy, average over 39 attributes, then average five draw-level macro metrics within each model run.
original_endpoint: Average probabilities over five retained draws in float64, then compute attribute metrics and average over attributes.
prerequisites: all original macro and attribute endpoints reproduce within 1e-12 before any new outcome
inference: Five paired model runs; mean, sample SD, unadjusted paired Student-t 95% intervals, exact two-sided sign flip, Hedges gz, Shapiro-Wilk diagnostics; Holm separately across all eight exploratory contrasts. Do not select tests from diagnostics.
